{{Quote|I am Pletus Croix of the Nabooian Historical Archives. When I heard of the discovery of all the ruins here on Mustafar, I just had to see them for myself. You see, there is no mention of them in any of the galactic records. I was studying the glyphs in the ruins north of here and was piecing together the story of Mustafar when the Coyn showed up.|Pletus Croix, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:UtS" />}}
[[File:PletusCroixSpeeder.jpg|thumb|left|Pletus Croix and his [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].]]

'''Pletus Croix''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] who investigated [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar's]] [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:UtS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pletus Croix was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG:UtS" />
